environment.note: rules §12.1 hard gate (checked live in the generating process); A11-style fingerprint/lock diff recorded as metadata only

scope.certificate_inputs: the three COMPLETE same-source full-range screen RUN directories; not outer launcher roots, not bridge probes

execution_notes: Fresh separate family outputs; sequential processes only: common scratch and stage paths must not be used concurrently.
Use High-RAM CPU conservatively. The screen notebook has a >10 GB minimum guard; this is not an empirical RAM/time guarantee.
Execute preflight again for each family; retain checks and all technical failure attempts.
Keep source/inventory fixed until all screens and certificate complete. Do not add this audit to the running source tree.
Use certificate-only CLI at the same 0.112.0 bytes. No --mt, --phasec, --probe-n, --instrument, --selftest-* or --evaluated inputs under this GO.
Certificate producer/current source identity must match; consumer environment is recorded, not the screen hard environment gate.

screen.scope: all rows [0,2000) of one specified family

certificate.scope: algebraic certificate over the accepted three complete screen-run evidence sets; no evaluated bridge/probe rows mixed in

conditions: One screen per family in order E2 -> E7 -> E8, each in a fresh child process with source/lock precheck and prelaunch, original first-wave D-2 bank, full registered paired 2000 rows, all three sizes and positions, N0/Nmax exact counts.

No shortcut gate removal, approximate counts, changed seeds, reordered or selected pseudo rows, or scientific result-dependent reruns. A technical failure stops the affected attempt, whose complete evidence is retained.
High-RAM CPU is recommended to leave margin; no bound on completion time/RSS from the 3-row bridge is claimed. No parallel use of shared scratch/staging paths.
Use one read-only 0.112.0 source epoch for all three producers and the certificate consumer. Source changes require a new pin/decision; do not relabel previous records.

Before the certificate, confirm each screen final/run completion, exact trusted20 gates, all true, provenance, correct family and [0,2000) range and published record hash/bytes; retain outer lock/final/log/notebook with the run directory.

Pass the three actual run_<attempt> directories via separate --screen arguments. Do not pass outer launcher directory, bridge probe, self-test screen, partial/subpartial or arbitrary --evaluated evidence under this decision.

Certificate-only entry needs --phaseb, --out, --screen x3, --target-commitment and --campaign-id, and the same source identity. It does not take --mt/--phasec or self-test/env-skip flags. Preserve stdout/stderr/command, consumer environment and input file hashes.
Certificate success is not global calibration completion, measured c/u/rate, or formal usable=False. A false impossibility predicate does not prove usable=True.
No final scientific certificate conclusion is accepted by this execution GO: submit the screen/certificate originals and executed notebooks for post-run audit.

Store this audit and bridge originals outside the fixed running tree until the same-source screen/certificate campaign has completed; later provenance registration must preserve historical execution bytes.
